name: Onan
bio: Onan is Judah's second son. After Er died, Judah, following the custom of the time, instructed Onan to marry his widowed sister-in-law Tamar and raise up offspring for his dead brother. Unwilling for any child to be counted as his brother's heir, Onan deliberately prevented Tamar from conceiving whenever he slept with her. This was evil in the sight of the LORD, and the LORD put him to death as well (Genesis 38:8-10).
